comment: D-082 compatibility guards. A guard that is on keeps its apps (identity-name prefixes), system components (components.json ids) and services (never set to disabled) out of the queue. Only dependencies that are certain: a guard that holds too much is switched off by the user, one that holds too little breaks the image. 'default': on for a new user.
